purpose: Teach: 迷わ/掴む/乗れる/はやく/はやり/思い出せ/逃げ出し/見落とし

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、本気で、絶対、迷わ、絶対、ないで、絶対、決めましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't second-guess yourself on the new menu. Let's decide it together, okay?
lines.style: Warm encouragement, steady eye contact. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone who believes in you before you believe in yourself. No rush, just certainty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の心、本気で、絶対、掴む、絶対、お料理、絶対、考え中、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's about really understanding what our customers need. That's what matters when we're thinking through the menu.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Looks inward slightly, then back at Mei. There's quiet conviction here—not self-doubt. Speaking from something she knows but hasn't quite voiced before.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、波に、絶対、乗れる、絶対、お店、絶対、目指そうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've got a real feel for what works. We can ride this momentum—build something we're both proud of.
lines.style: Bright but grounded. A small smile. The tempo picks up slightly with 「波に乗れる」—genuine excitement underneath the steadiness. Reaching toward the future together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、明日の準備、本気で、絶対、はやく、絶対、終わらせるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'll get tomorrow's prep done quickly so we have time to focus on what really matters.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no dramatics. Practical efficiency in the tone. This is a promise quietly made—the work will be done so we can think bigger.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、はやり、絶対、のデザート、絶対、お店に入れたら?メイちゃん
lines.en: What if we put one of those trending desserts on the menu? Do you think it would fit us?
lines.style: Curious, open-ended. Softer attack than before. This is Aoi thinking out loud with Mei, testing an idea. Genuinely asking, not performing knowing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の名前、本気で、絶対、思い出せ、絶対、ない時、絶対、申し訳ないよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Sometimes I worry I'll forget a regular's name and let them down somehow.
lines.style: A flicker of self-consciousness. Quiet, honest admission. The tone of someone sharing a small vulnerability with a person she trusts. Slightly wry but not hiding behind humor.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お忙しい時、本気で、絶対、逃げ出し、絶対、たくなる気持ち、絶対、分かるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I understand that feeling—wanting to escape when it all gets too much. That's real, and it's okay.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing. Aoi is meeting Mei's confession without judgment. Slow, assured pace. The voice of someone who has felt the same thing and lived through it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お会計、本気で、絶対、見落とし、絶対、ないようにね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just be careful with the till tomorrow, okay? Those small mistakes add up.
lines.style: Practical closing note, but with warmth. Not a lecture—a real look of care. Brief, direct, the way you speak to someone you're looking out for.
